source_or_gap: The book covered gradient optimizers and policy objectives but did not name evolution strategies, zeroth-order learning, neuroevolution, or local forward-only credit assignment, creating an unintended backpropagation-and-policy-gradient monoculture.
chapter_action_policy: Deepen Governed Model Training as the owner of learning-rule identity and transaction state, then add bounded consequences to policy optimization, substrate ABI, total-cost accounting, and theory transport. Do not create a duplicate learning-method chapter.
merge_or_split_policy: A learning rule changes the same training-run identity, mutable state, evaluator, resource denominator, qualification, checkpoint, and rollback contracts already owned by Governed Model Training. Adjacent chapters consume those semantics without duplicating them.
boundary_decision_rationale: EGGROLL materially broadens the mechanism taxonomy but does not introduce a distinct stack interface. Its strongest lesson is that the learning rule must be replaceable and governed inside the existing training transaction.
external_literature_need: future primary work on scalable perturbation estimators, quality-diversity search, and local credit assignment
independent matched comparisons that count total evaluator calls, candidate failures, data exposure, GPU-hours, and energy
cross-architecture evidence separating the learning rule from recurrent, Transformer, and quantized substrate advantages
proof_or_test_backlog: extend the Training Run Contract with learning-rule family, population, perturbation, fitness, and aggregate-update state
design matched first-order and zeroth-order positive controls before accepting either positive or negative conclusions
report kernel throughput separately from total useful outcomes per accelerator-hour, energy, evaluator call, and data item
evidence_transition_precondition: competent implementations and method-specific rescue for each learning family
frozen objective, evaluator, data exposure, perturbation policy, population denominator, and total-cost ledger
independent final evaluation and accepted claim-specific evidence transition
required_before_drafting: completed: primary source review for EGGROLL, OpenAI ES, MeZO, and Forward-Forward
completed: source-scoped claims and compute caveats
promotion_blockers: no local ES, zeroth-order, or Forward-Forward implementation has been executed
source throughput and quality results are configuration-bound
architecture and learning-rule effects are not causally separated
no accepted evidence transition promotes a chapter-core claim
residuals: quality-diversity, indirect encoding, synthetic gradients, equilibrium learning, and biological-local learning remain future literature-refresh candidates rather than implied omissions
next_action: Keep the integrated taxonomy current and require any future training method to declare its state, evaluator, credit path, candidate denominator, and total resource ledger before comparison.
non_claims: does not create a new chapter
does not prove EGGROLL or any alternative learning rule superior
does not reproduce a cited experiment
does not promote support or authorize training, deployment, or release
